correction: A test of the GitHub sign-in must hold the fake device-flow poll until its action ran: the fake code's expiry is past, so a poll that waits only on its context answers at once and can end the code phase before RunUntil sees it. A test that checks a late answer saves nothing must wait until that answer ran on the UI thread.
